reviews.text:
I would read the reviews that are negative and glean the pattern. Fear mongering, very rude owner and staff.

It’s a pattern. I’m sure he’s done great by some people. But I’d be weary.

We have a 80lb AmStaff, Lab & Husky mix, Venchi. For 2 years, he dragged me on our walks and we were always on his agenda. We have done other "trainings" before and were not seeing any results. We reached out to Josh and had a great long chat with him and thought his approach is different than what we have done but we wanted to try based on all the great reviews. Well..long story short, his methods are legit and the positive reviews are true. 10 months later between private and group classes, our relationship with Venchi has changed and grown- he respects and trusts us. He walks right by my side when we go on walks. He doesn't get distracted or startled by other dogs or squirrels. He constantly checks in with us and seeks permission and guidance. I am comfortable with walking him by myself, without the husband. Josh truly has a great understanding of the psychology and behavior of dogs. The result-driven cirriculum does work. Honestly, life-changing.

Houston Dog Works is the best dog training facility in Houston and extended area by far. He’s done amazing work with my Brittany on obedience and gun dog training — including a reliable retrieve that other trainers couldn’t achieve. Highly recommend and I can’t wait to continue training on advanced work

The training program is intense, but the results don’t lie!! I have been a client for almost a year now, and my dog has improved so much in his obedience and as a companion. I cannot speak highly enough of Josh and the team, they are genuinely great people and are immensely talented at what they do. Training here has given me a great appreciation for well-trained dogs and has set the bar high. Give them a shout, you won’t regret it!

We’ve had such a great experience with Houston Dog Works! From day one, the team has been professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring with our dog. You can tell Josh and his team truly love what they do!
We went for the group class and they kept great control of every dog the whole time. I’ve never felt so safe with my dog off leash around other dogs.

Josh and the entire crew at Houston DogWorks are amazing. They are truly the best trainers in Houston and beyond. They use methods backed by science and have the resume to prove it works. They have worked miracles with our Brittany in both behavioral and gun dog work. I would highly recommend to anyone looking to really train their dog.
The best, most realistic and most knowledgeable trainer in town. I can say without a doubt their passion for dogs and their wellbeing, stands above all other trainers in Houston.
Josh was very professional. I would definitely trust my dog to be left there again. 100% satisfied.

The owner was incredibly aggressive and rude to my wife. He uses scare tactics to try and get you to commit to his service. Without even seeing our dogs, he was telling my wife that if we don't start using his dog training service that we will likely need to put our dog down.

The owner of the business proceeded to invoice us $250 Without providing any services.

The owner is an unethical person and I highly recommend you look elsewhere.

Couldn’t be happier with my experience at Houston Dogworks.

As a first time dog owner, I committed to consuming anything and everything I could get my hands on about dog training. Countless videos, articles, and books were watched and read, and I still ended up feeling overwhelmed with lack of direction, contradictory information, and how little progress my adolescent dog and I had made.

After enrolling in and completing their foundations program, I am so happy with where we are today. Josh and Kennedy provided all the tools and education necessary to get us on our way and put the daily work in.

In short, we got the structure we needed, and I am so excited to continue working with them in more advanced work!

Update three years later:

My dog and I have long completed the off-leash curriculum at Dogworks. After that, we were also coached through a trained retrieve and so much more. I can truly say my dog is 100% reliable when I need him to be. I often get stopped at parks with him and get asked if I'm a dog trainer. Nope, I was just taught how to handle my dog by the best place in town (maybe the state).

We still visit for the monthly maintenance classes and social events that Dogworks hosts on for clients who have gone through their program. Through the years, I've seen many dogs grow into fine young citizens as their owners roll up their sleeves and put the work in. Some have won blue ribbons at obedience competitions, earned perfect scores in hunt tests, and molded into trustworthy working dogs.

I can't thank Houston Dogworks enough for coaching us through it all and for giving me the tools I needed to live the best life with my dog.

We’ve had a great experience with Houston DogWorks! Josh and Kennedy are fantastic to work with—knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested in both the dogs and their owners. They prepared us extremely well for the CGC test, which we passed with confidence. Training sessions are positive, well-structured, and effective. Highly recommend!

Houston DogWorks is the only place I trust with my dog.
Josh and Kennedy have transformed my relationship with my dog - not just through work with him but also by working with me on how I handle him. Before Houston DogWorks, having friends over, taking him in public places, even simple handling would give me anxiety due to my dogs behavior - he would bark, jump, show aggression over simple things, jump on the couch without permission.

Houston DogWorks helped me set and uphold boundaries with my pup. The whole process has allowed me to trust my dog, understand him, and know how to keep him accountable to do the hard things - giving him the life that we both deserve.
Anyone who tries to commit you on a get trained quick pitch isn’t selling lasting results - this as well as anything else will not work unless you do. And if you’re working, the Houston Dog Works team is working right alongside you.
Great people. Great results. Great community. I truly cannot recommend this training enough!

Did you get a puppy and then immediately have the worst puppy blues ever because you got no sleep, the puppy was crazy, and turned your life upside down? We did too. I truly can’t say enough about Josh and Kennedy and the impact that they have had on me, my husband, and our black lab. Josh and Kennedy give you the real support and actual feedback you need.

After crying about every day and fully regretting getting the cutest puppy, I stumbled across Houston Dogworks on Google. Desperately trying to get our lives back, I called and got to talk to Josh, one of the trainers. He listened to not only me cry but also my puppy crying in the back who refused to be crate trained. We went to Houston Dogworks in hope of just getting him crate trained and potty trained and told ourselves we could figure the rest out in time. Here we are still today, having graduated puppy training and now working in their Obedience Foundations class to get our now 1 year old AKC Canine Good Citizen Certification with hopes of moving into their advanced training courses.

If you told me when I got this puppy that not only does my dog walk in a heel on my side, auto sit when I stop walking, does what he’s commanded, and is actually crate trained … I’d probably assume the puppy blues has genuinely made me manic.

Josh and Kennedy put the work in to help not only train your dog in a way that fits them but also train you. From puppy work to advanced off leash training, Houston Dogworks will have what you (and your dog) need to actually enjoy all the things that come with having a dog. I feel confident in myself when handling my dog because they not only tell you how to do it, but why you should do it. Josh and Kennedy have so much knowledge and experience that truly set them apart from other “trainers”. They are the real deal and they actually care about you and your dog.

Get your life back!! Houston Dogworks has truly  made the difference in our life and our dog, let them help you with yours!
Doofus always has so much fun at large group social and loves Josh.

There’s a big difference between “pop” dog training (all the nonsense you see on social media and TV) vs learning the proper fundamentals that are going to set YOU, and your four legged friends, up for life.

Josh and the team at DogWorks are educators, not just people to try and “fix” your dog(s). They’re trying to set you up for the truest form of success, which is an awesome companionship with fido, where fido is truly feeling their best (not just nervously waiting for a treat).

10/10 recommend Houston Dog Works.

Best in the business!  They don’t just train your dog, they give you the tools to allow you to train your dog.  The freedom provided by the training concepts is profound.  While it does require commitment to the training concepts and the homework expected, do your and your dog justice by setting the dog up for success in all aspects of life. It’s beyond enjoyable to be able to take your dog out in public and not worry about how they will react to all the environmental distractions or encounters with other dogs and humans.  Can’t recommend Josh and his team at Houston DogWorks enough!

I attended a problem solving seminar today and was blown away with Josh and his crew! Ive been showing dogs on and off for 30 years and its rare to find someone who understands of how to train a dog AND how to teach people to train a dog. I will definitely be back!

We have been training at Houston DogWorks since our dog was a puppy and we are thrilled with the results. Not only does our dog learn valuable skills, we have learned how to be better handlers. I highly recommend Houston DogWorks for all your training needs!

Houston DogWorks is amazing, and works too. The owner has expectations of both the dog and the owner, and if you don’t work with your dog it won’t work. Since we started with here our dog has gone from bananas to manageable. Thank you for giving us the tools for success. I highly recommend this place they know what they’re doing!!

We had our dog trained for several months with a hunting focus at another trainer but he was still very difficult to manage at home.  We tried Houston Dog Works and have been very happy with the changes we are seeing in ours dog’s obedience and general demeanor. A big part of the changes we are seeing is due to Josh and Kennedy’s approach to training us the owners as much as it is the training of our dog. As first time sporting dog owners this “train the owner” was key.

Amazing trainer for dogs and people alike. Extremely knowledgeable people who do nothing but set people and dogs up to succeed. They will give you all the information you need to succeed in anything. They teach the foundations you need from pet dog to sport dog.

My dog Nova is COMPLETELY changed for the better. She had confidence issues and leash problems to start. After two sessions, her confidence completely turned around. And after a few months, she was much better on the leash. Today we are working on the off-leash curriculum and can’t wait to see her keep progressing. I strongly recommend all dog owners go through the program with Josh and Kennedy. They know their stuff!
If you want to have a good relationship with you dog come here. My GSD is calmer and I know how to cue her and set her up for success.
Frankie apparently wanted to practice off leash tonight. Sorry about the incident at the beginning 🤣 Would of given 5-1/2 stars if it wasn’t for the music. …
Hands (and paws) down, the best dog trainer. They have helped us learn how to give our shepherd the best life. Can’t recommend them enough!

Before finding this dog training facility, I honestly didn’t know if things would ever get better. My dog had serious issues with both people and other dogs—he was reactive, aggressive, and unpredictable, even with members of my own household. Fast forward to now, and he’s a completely different dog. He’s earned his Canine Good Citizen title, and people constantly stop me to compliment how well-behaved he is. Men, women, children—even the elderly—can pet him without a second thought. It's like having a new lease on life with him.

I chose the DIY program, and I couldn’t believe how doable and empowering it was. For those with tighter schedules, there’s also a board and train option, but either way, Josh and Kennedy have created something special. They're not only incredibly knowledgeable, but they're passionate about what they do, and somehow they make training fun.

The biggest change? My dog now looks to me for direction. I’ve unlocked the ability to take him anywhere. Parks, patios, trails—he’s right there with me, calm and confident. Our relationship has completely transformed. He’s not just tolerable now—he’s a sweet boy that everyone genuinely loves to be around.

If you’re on the fence, let me say this: if you’re ready to get control and do the things you’ve always wanted to do with your dog, Josh and Kennedy can figure it out. They did for me—and my dog was no easy case. Thanks again HDW, looking forward to continuing our education with y’all!

If you are willing to listen and do the work (emphasis on work), you will be blown away by where you end up with your dog. My dog was impossible to handle with stranger and other dogs and now I can confidently handle him around anyone. Josh and Kennedy are the best trainers I have worked with and I am more than happy that I pulled the trigger. Do you and your dog a favor and call them.

We came to Houston DogWorks after having several experiences with other dog trainers that taught basic commands but did not yield the results we were looking for. We were drawn in by the behavior based approach; they do not use treats or shock collars. We went for the self train option instead of board and train so that we could learn along with the dogs. You have to be willing to put in the time, but it is definitely worth it. Josh and Kennedy are extremely knowledgeable and will work with you to help you and your dog succeed. Overall, we have had a great experience at Houston DogWorks.

We have worked with Josh at Houston Dog Works for almost 2 years now, and have made great strides with both Obedience and Field Work with our Large Munsterlander, Vesper. With a Versatile Hunting Dog, it can be tough to find people with experience working Pointing Breeds, but Josh is an excellent asset for those in the Houston Metro.

As a first time handler, Josh spent as much time and attention teaching us, as he did our pup.
Having gone through Puppy Training, Board & Train, Obedience, Group Classes, and currently Force Fetch, I can certainly say that Josh has helped us build up our little puppy into a lovely working dog.

Josh and Kennedy take their jobs seriously and expect you, the dog owner, to take training seriously, too. HDW is the best in Houston if you want a well-adjusted, responsive doggo! Can’t say enough good things!

We brought our dog here when he was about 1 1/2. We had already tried puppy school and a couple of rounds of positi e reinforcement training and our dog was still of control.

It was wally hard to make the decision to leave him in board and train but the results have been worth it. We have a well trained dog who is easy to take out in public now.

Couldn't recommend Houston Dogworks enough. One year after starting, my dog is a fully adjusted companion that can go anywhere with me. Aside from the incredible command-based control we have over her now, the relationship I have with her is unbelievable. I am such a fan of the Dogworks approach & would do it all over again (and will if we get another dog). Enjoy some pics of my Dogworks-trained dog from our 6 week cross country road trip : )

Seriously, where to start. Our 11 pound American Hairless Terrier was a true terrorist. She bit our daughter, neighbor, and grandmother. She snapped at a little girl’s face, and she slipped out of our gate and chased a dog down the street to attack it. People always want to pet her since she’s hairless. But we couldn’t risk it. We tried a certified veterinarian behaviorist and were on the brink of sending her back to the breeder. Then we found Houston DogWorks. We immediately trusted Josh and Kennedy’s methods. After a six week board and train we started working with her ourselves. Guided by Josh and Kennedy we learned leash healing, sit, down, stay, etc. Their methods have tamed our tiny beast. She loves going up to people now. She earned her Canine Good Citizenship and can now handle a room full of people and dogs with ease. We are forever grateful to Houston DogWorks. ❤️

Can’t say enough good things about Houston DogWorks! Great team, super clean facility and most importantly, top notch dog training. Josh is an extremely knowledgeable and talented trainer. He’ll be the first to tell you that success will require commitment, but what’s awesome is he strives to make the training process enjoyable for both you AND your dog. Definitely recommend!

Update 1/2025:
Josh and the HDW team helped me get my second dog about 6 months ago. They went above and behind to make sure the integration of the new dog with my existing dog was as smooth as possible. And when my new dog got critically ill, they stepped up and helped however they could. Truly above and beyond. We’ve now been through training and my new dog is doing great. Everything I said above is still true today. If you commit here you will be successful. Thanks Josh & Kennedy!

Edit: His response just reiterates the arrogance and unprofessionalism I sniffed in 24 hours... I found a great trainer for $975. Just wanted to let people know this guy doesn't seem to be the nicest.

This guy may be a great trainer. I'll never know because I am not in the right tax bracket. Charge what you charge, I get it. But if you're going to charge 2x the average, be transparent upfront.

The issue is the arrogance and gross unprofessionalism that was evident before I stepped foot in his facility. He also told me I'd have a dead dog if I didn't do something soon (but also said he was my only option). That's just manipulative salesmanship.

In my initial discovery call with him (20min) he spent a good 5 minutes talking about how he is the only qualified dog trainer in Houston (3rd largest city in US) and everyone else is stealing your money and teaching your dog nonsense. Mind you, I had let him I know I've worked with other Houston trainers before. Felt like a bit of a waste of our time on the call.
Seemed to be a bit of a red flag, but I hadn't met the guy so I was interested to hear what he had to say as he's the self-proclaimed "expert" in Houston. He sent me some dates. I asked what it costs before committing to that. I was expecting $1500-2000 with some payment plan options based on my research so far.

He gave me a range $2500-$5000 with no standardized outline that determines where it would fall in there. No explanation of programs. When I asked about payment plans, he said he only does them for the more expensive packages and in any scenario, you have to have $2500 upfront. I volunteer at a rescue and am constantly taking in strays, I will never have that kind of money for one dog. I make a humble living. I didn't know dog training was for the rich. I expressed this, asking if he had anyone affordable ones he'd be able to recommend. He said no, everyone else in Houston is "junk."

He also stated that because my 10 month old dog has attempted to bite me and my partner, "you have a very serious problem on your hands that is going to end up with a dead dog before he's 2 if you don't get on top of it."

To say that, if you don't have at least $2500 tomorrow, you will have a dead dog in your home, is absolutely diabolical behavior. And I'm sure he would've insisted on the most expensive package on us and it would've been well into $4-5k.

Trust me, I know everyone has to make their money, I work in tech sales myself. But to tell someone if they don't have a month's salary to drop on their dog they're essentially F'd and will end up with a dead dog is not only unnecessary but I'd say cruel and unethical. This guy needs a lesson on communication and morality.

There are simply no better trainers than Josh & his team. We tried many other training programs before finding Houston Dog Works and all other programs never seemed to work with our dog. So many other trainings were focused on treat based training methods which ended up with our dog just doing whatever he needed for the treat and us not fixing the long-term behavioral issues he experienced. However, at HDW, we have had nothing but success & long lasting, real results.

Josh & his team provide true obedience training for you & your dog, focused on training methods that provide long term results, not just in the moment results. They don’t just teach you the skills you need as a dog owner but also the “why” behind all of their training methods.

In addition to their traditional training programs, HDW continues to offer unique training sessions to further expand your dogs training skill set. What I love so much about HDW is that they are just as dedicated to the results & overall well-being of your dog as you are. With continued open session trainings & unique trainings outside of the "classroom", HDW ensures that they continue to assist you in whatever way possible. They do not operate as a "once & done" dog training - they are truly there to support you throughout the lifetime of your dog.

While the training at HDW takes time, commitment & consistency, Josh & his team are with you every step of the way. They will provide you with the right tools & skills to ensure that you feel comfortable & operate as the best owner/handler of your dog.

We have been dedicated to HDW for a few years now and we give it our absolute highest recommendation. Our dog (and us!) have grown so much over the years and watching our dog become more comfortable with himself & in various different environments has been incredible.

We truly cannot thank Josh, Kennedy & Molly enough.

I started training at the BEST dog training facility in Texas when my puppy was 8-weeks old. Not only have I found a new hobby and community of dog lovers, the phenomenal obedience training at Houston DogWorks equipped Malakai for life in the real world. Though I love winning obedience competitions and seeing new clients learn each week in group classes, the best part of the training here is that it’s reliable enough to save my dog’s life!

One day a cat darted out from a bush by my doorstep. Malakai sprinted after it with no leash on, straight toward the street and right in front of a car. Two words (“Malakai, come!”) was all it took for him to turn on a dime and run back toward me. There’s no way to quantify the relief I felt in that moment. I’m immensely grateful to Josh & Kennedy for the bulletproof, amazing and foundational obedience training that saved Malakai’s life and allows me to enjoy my dog both inside and outside of my home.

I joined Houston DogWorks when my goblin border collie (if you know you know) was 12 weeks. Now at 14 months, we've done the Power Puppy Program, General Obedience, and the Advanced Obedience programs. I can confidently say this training has transformed our lives.

DogWorks focuses is on true obedience (not basic tricks), where your dog follows commands because they want to—not because you're a vending machine of snacks. It does require a little more work, but you get lasting results, even in high-distraction environments. My dog now obeys off-leash, no matter what’s going on around us.

The training is as much about you as it is about your dog. It’s a joint effort that requires commitment, consistency, and teamwork. The trainers equip you with the skills and tools to lead your dog effectively, and the process ends up forging a bond between you and your pup in ways I've personally never had before.

Their programs are designed for long-term success, with each stage building on the last. From foundational skills to advanced polishing, the transformation has been incredible—not just in my dog’s behavior but in the trust and connection we now share.

Houston Dogworks is the place to train your dog, hands down. We brought my 2 dogs in, different ages, and trained all the way through Josh's obedience program. We learned so much that it's hard to state the most important lesson. I can definitely say that Josh, Kennedy, and the whole Dogworks community have taught us more than we could have asked for. I think we am most proud of the confidence we have to take either of our dogs with us just about anywhere without fear that they will lunge for another dog, run away off-leash, or even break a down-stay at all. The private lessons, group classes, and off-site activities are awesome & allowed us to be around people who cared about their dogs in the same ways as us & brought us new friends.

Side note, our dogs are both shelter adoptions with different backgrounds. Josh & Kennedy really tailored their guidance to our dogs' breeds & personalities, which really highlights their skills. Thank you Houston Dogworks!
- Brenda/o

I rescued a Belgian Mal that was wound up tight and abused fs. Josh and Kennedy were able to unwound the tightest knot and now I can take my dog to any brewery. They give you an easy to follow curriculum and the trainers are great people.

For those of you serious about training your dogs, this is the place!

I am writing this review (and I don’t write many) 1.5 years into training with …

If you are interesting in getting real results that last, I would highly recommend taking your dogs to Houston DogWorks. It takes time, commitment, and patience, but the results will come if you put in the work. Josh and Kennedy do …

We are so grateful for Houston DogWorks! We knew that training rooted in best practices would be critically important in making our goal of owning a steady, reliable dog come to fruition. Josh’s in-depth knowledge of the science behind dog …
Josh & Kennedy have helped with so many dogs I’ve worked with through the years. Clear concise instructions for both the dog & handler. …

Loved working with Houston DogWorks from the beginning. Josh is very knowledgeable and answered all of our questions and concerns from day one. They were able to put together a plan that worked for our dog specifically, and guided us …
